title: compare on an int64# array raises in native code and answers in bytecode
summary: `compare`, `=`, `Hashtbl.hash` and `Marshal` on an `int64#` array or a `#(int * int)` array raise `Invalid_argument` ("mixed block value") in native code and give an answer in bytecode. `float#` arrays are compared in both.
cause: `runtime/compare.c`, `hash.c` and `extern.c` raise on a mixed block; in bytecode an unboxed array is not one.
